CREATE PROC [DW].[HIST_SP_DW_FACTTRUSTFUNDVALUE] AS
BEGIN
WITH CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation
AS(
	SELECT BUB.CustomerAccountId,  COUNT(InternalCustomerId) CNT FROM [BNKM].[UITFAUMBalance] BUB
	LEFT JOIN (SELECT InternalCustomerId,BaseAccountId FROM BNKM.CustomerRelatedBaseAccount) BCRB ON BUB.BaseAccountId = BCRB.BaseAccountId
	GROUP BY BUB.CustomerAccountId)

,TFV_BAL AS (
SELECT
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,BUB.BalanceTimestamp,112) AS BusinessDateSK
	,-1 AS BranchSK
	,DDK.BankSK AS BankSK
	,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
	,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
	,BUB.TotalBalanceAmount AS AUMAmountFull
	,BUB.TotalBalanceAmount/ISNULL(NULLIF(CAP.CNT,''),1)  AS AUMAmountProrated
	,BUB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM [BNKM].[UITFAUMBalance] BUB
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA	ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 

LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDK 	ON BUB.FinancialInstitutionId = DDK.BankID
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA		ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID

LEFT JOIN CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation CAP ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = CAP.CustomerAccountId
WHERE DDA.AccountSK IS NOT NULL

UNION ALL

-- NonUITF --
SELECT
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,BUB.BalanceTimestamp,112) AS BusinessDateSK
	,-1 AS BranchSK
	,DDK.BankSK AS BankSK
	,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
	,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
	,BUB.BalanceAmount AS AUMAmountFull
	,BUB.BalanceAmount/ISNULL(NULLIF(CAP.CNT,''),1)   AS AUMAmountProrated
	,BUB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM [BNKM].[NonUITFAUMBalance] BUB
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId

LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDK ON BUB.FinancialInstitutionId = DDK.BankID
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA	ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID

LEFT JOIN CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation CAP ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = CAP.CustomerAccountId
WHERE DDA.AccountSK IS NOT NULL)

,DISTINCT_BALANCE AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
    '-1' AS BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountId ,BusinessDateSK ,AUMAmountFull ,AUMAmountProrated ,SourceSystemCode ,WorkFlowId ,TaskRunId ,InsertDttm
FROM TFV_BAL
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL))

INSERT INTO [DW].[FactTrustFundValue_TEST_20230706]
SELECT 
    BusinessDateSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AUMAmountFull
    ,AUMAmountProrated
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
FROM DISTINCT_BALANCE

END
GO
